summary: Add Wave 2 MCP tool affordance and client-profile conformance requirements so Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClo/OpenClaw, Hermes-style clients, and small-to-frontier models select and use save_document and smart_search reliably.
implied_requirements: No new MCP tools beyond the existing eight-tool Wave 2 contract.
Conformance fixtures should be deterministic and should not require live external LLM clients.
Validation errors must be corrective but redacted.
